shortDescription.default: Shows the page owner, last confirmed date, and open review requests.

longDescription.default: Verified Page Banner shows who owns a modern page and when it was last confirmed current. Owners and editors can confirm the page and see how many review requests are still open. Readers can flag a page when they can add items to the Page Review Requests list. A site owner can optionally let visitors add requests. The web part does not call Microsoft Graph and does not request API permissions.

features.title: Verified Page Banner
features.description: Activates Verified Page Banner on this site.
